text_block_list.text:
Having safely made it through
our first three years in the Twinkle Series, we—

Finally, in order to achieve Satono Crown's longtime goal
of becoming a world-renowned Umamusume,
we drew up plans to take on the world stage.
And so—

Finally, with our trip abroad looming on the following day...
Satono Crown and I were doing, well...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Onigiri, tamagoyaki, miso soup!
Simmered vegetables, and charcoal-grilled yakitori.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And plenty of other things besides. We were treated
to so many real "must-have" items!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
As expected, a shopping street with this kind of vibe is packed with good old-fashioned charm!
The food tasted amazing too♪
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. It definitely tasted good, but—

text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you eat plenty of
what one might call 'familiar Japanese food.'"

At Satono Crown's suggestion,
we came to eat at a traditional shopping street near the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a common saying, but that's precisely why
you really shouldn't take it lightly.
I mean the part about 'longing for Japanese food.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Diet has a major impact
on day-to-day performance.
We should take whatever measures we can in advance!

"...While what they're saying makes a lot of sense,
still—"

In the first place, the phenomenon of "craving something" occurs
because "something you used to eat on a daily basis
is no longer available to be eaten."
Going by that logic, Satono Crown—as a young lady of the Satono Group, someone accustomed to high-class meals—she would...

"Could someone really yearn for
Japanese 'commoner food' like what we just ate...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you finally notice?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You've got it right, Trainer. This isn't about me, it's—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: A dinner party just for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I did plenty of research, mainly focusing
on your colleagues and parents,
but how did it turn out?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I hope it was to your liking.
Though I did prioritize 'traditional Japanese food' to suit our purpose.
choice_data_list: I-I mean, I'm totally satisfied, but still...!

text_block_list.text:
I'm amazed by how thoroughly prepared she is, but
I can't help feeling a bit flustered.

After all, she was leaving Japan tomorrow.
Shouldn't this time have rightfully been spent for her sake instead?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Heehee.

...As all these thoughts swirled through my head,
Satono Crown gave my forehead a gentle, playful flick.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I can read whatever you're thinking
like an open book, you know."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I must firmly deny it.
It's not 'for my sake.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It's 'for our sake.'
Could you please think of it that way?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In short...
—I'll be expecting the same from you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "I'm not the only one who needs to put on a top-tier performance, right?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"At least from me, I will demand it of you.
Both your strength and your resolve. Everything you can possibly give."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because that is an indispensable requirement
for 'us' to achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Be aware of that, okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Good!
You look much better now. Keep it up♪

Seeing Satono Crown smile at me fills my chest with warmth.
I can feel her trust.
...But I can't let myself get complacent here.

She's always been the one guiding me, teaching me.
Even so—

So that I can properly walk ahead of her when needed,
I want to be someone who never stops thinking and striving.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
What's wrong, Trainer?
choice_data_list: On second thought, let's go where you want to go too.
On second thought, let's go where you want to go too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, you're so stubborn.
choice_data_list: Because I want you to give it your absolute best, too.
Because I want you to give it your absolute best, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I know, partner!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then you'd better keep me company the whole way.
...First, let's take in this gorgeous night view together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to make a vow, setting
the right mood is important, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Overseas.
I'll definitely claim it, Trainer.

...Reflecting the brilliant night view in her eyes.
Holding countless jewels within her gaze,
Satono Crown continues.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"First to Hong Kong.
Then on to France and Dubai.
To raise a crown of glory that will echo throughout the world."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To make her name known across the world—
and become the greatest, most legendary Umamusume in history.

I nod without hesitation.
Then, for a moment, we gaze at each other.
Brimming with dreams, ideals, and an absolute conviction to see them through—facing that gaze I had watched for so long, the words slipped out.
choice_data_list: I really love... those eyes of yours.
I really love... those eyes of yours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Eh?
Just then.

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um... I-I'm so sorry!

Suddenly, someone called out to me... Looking over,
I saw an Umamusume standing there
with a still-youthful face.

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry to bother you out of the blue.
But um... I just, I really needed to...!

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Crown-san!!
Um... good luck overseas!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, thank you.
But, is that all?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like there's more
you want to tell me, though."

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I.
I saw a dream in your running."

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "I wanted to be like you. To hold my head high, have confidence, and seize glory...!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
And then?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: What made you decide to aim for that?

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...The crown that holds everyone's dreams!

text_block_list.name: Green-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I want to win the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Right. ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Such lovely eyes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay.
Everything will definitely be fine. Because your eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You have the same color as me—
the color of someone destined to achieve great things!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, eyes are mirrors.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "In her eyes as she looked at me, a steadfast determination equal to my own seemed to be seething."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Eyes are like mirrors.
...In mine, you'll always find the thrill and excitement you gave me. Always.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Your own reflection is mirrored there.
